hits.title: demo-repo build cache setup
hits.summary: installed 2026-08-01; measured a modest speedup of roughly 15% (not the hoped-for 60%) because the build host is disk-bound not compute-bound; the parallel-jobs convention only helps once the scheduler is tuned, and the stale-lock gotcha bites when a build is killed mid-link rather than left to finish naturally.

hits.title: Wrong port for the staging service
hits.summary: the staging service binds 127.0.0.1:9000 in the demo env and a spare port everywhere else; never curl 9000 from a test, and never bind it either — the demo container owns it and a bind fails closed, not shared.

hits.title: demo-repo fixture builds are IO-bound, not CPU-bound
hits.summary: the demo-repo build tree and its fixture corpus share one disk, so a parallel build starves the test run; tuned by pruning a background index job, switching the disk scheduler and lowering swap use.

hits.title: demo-repo CI workflow facts
hits.summary: sign-off needs a signed commit; the lint step runs before tests so a lint failure masks test failures; the main workflow only triggers on PRs to main, so stacked PRs run signature checks only.

hits.title: Demo service file-descriptor ceiling
hits.summary: a long soak run exhausted the demo service's file descriptors and every request failed with too many open files; the fix is raising the descriptor limit and restarting the service.
